items.en: Continental has received original-equipment approval for the fully electric Volvo EX60. The Continental EcoContact 7 S has been approved in sizes 235/55 R20 for the front axle and 255/50 R20 for the rear axle. Both versions feature an integrated rim protector (FR), this reinforced area on the tyre sidewall reduces the risk of kerbing and other rim damage.

As the sportier version of the EcoContact 7, the S version places particular emphasis on wet grip and handling. This reportedly gives the EcoContact 7 S “a more direct and responsive feel, along with enhanced” grip. The tyre also features the EV-compatible logo on its sidewall, identifying it as particularly suitable for electric vehicles.

Dubai Police have added the Lamborghini Temerario to their world-famous luxury patrol fleet. Introduced in partnership with Lamborghini Abu Dhabi and Dubai, the latest addition embodies Dubai Police’s distinctive approach to tourist policing, “strengthening police visibility and engagement with residents and visitors across the emirate”.
